title: Low Fuel, Range, and Low Settings
summary: This topic mixes low-fuel alerts, range estimates, and settings described as too low, with most excerpts too fragmentary to determine a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: One review positively mentions the vehicle behavior when fuel is low, but the exact praised feature is not fully described.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention low fuel use, a heads-up display set too low, loud A/C at low fan speed, and range estimates or displayed range perceived as low or unstable, but the short fragments do not consistently show clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes several unrelated subjects, including fuel level alerts, fuel economy, EV range, heads-up display position, and A/C fan behavior.
Most excerpts are very short or incomplete, so sentiment and the exact customer concern are often unclear.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
